lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of circular high-luminance pixel clusters forming approximately five vertical columns and four horizontal rows posterior to the pectoral fin zone.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity align with the centroids of the circular blobs, creating a distinct grid where the blobs act as nodes within the vertical stripes.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three parallel longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with higher pixel values on the dorsal aspect and lower values on the ventral aspect.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Approximately seven high-luminance blobs are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, primarily clustered in the lower and posterior regions of the fin surface.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of at least five remoras (Echeneidae) attached to the ventral and lower lateral regions of the subject.
